name: rail-host-glyph-leading-box
description: The real host rail row and the real activity watch row share the drawn-mark grammar: each SVG occupies the same fixed 13px leading box despite independent CSS modules. A wider host glyph shifts its label and breaks that grammar.

mutation.declaration: RailRow.module.css: .hostGlyph's width reverted from 13px to 17px (the host mark outgrows the glyph grammar's leading box)
mutation.note: The real HostRow glyph measures 17px against the real activity WatchRow glyph at 13px and fails on width; restoring width: 13px returns PASS.
